name: AGES Industri AB (publ)
summary: AGES Industri AB (publ) focuses on the production of precise components, offering expertise in die casting, machining, tool manufacturing, welding, and assembly. The company's operations include the die casting of aluminum; the meticulous machining of materials such as stainless steel, brass, iron, and aluminum; and both automated robotic and manual welding for exact products. Additionally, AGES provides extensive component and system assembly, complete with testing, and employs rheocasting, an advanced semi-solid casting technique. It also undertakes the design and creation of specialized casting tools. Serving a wide array of sectors, the company's clientele includes the heavy and light vehicle industries, general industrial applications, material handling, agriculture and outdoor, infrastructure, marine, and medical technology. Established in 1983, its head office is situated in Halmstad, Sweden, with a significant international presence spanning Sweden, Belgium, North America, Poland, the Netherlands, France, and Germany.
